urls_metadata in JSON string format "{url_key: {key: value, ...}, ...}". Will get records whose url_metadata have at least one key containing the substring "url_key" AND whose url_metadata have all the "key: value" properties
metadata in format key:value. Multiple metadata values can be specified, for example "?metadata=a:xxx&metadata=b:yyy"
hash in format hash_type:hash_value. Multiple hashes can be specified, for example "?hash=a:xxx&hash=b:yyy"

pagination params(start, limit) are not supported
URL to query. Multiple URLs can be specified, for example "?url=url1&url=url2" - in that case, returned records will have ALL URLs
comma delimited ACE - if multiple ACE are specified, returned records will have ALL ACEs
comma delimited resources - if multiple resources are specified, returned records will have ALL resources

The negate params in JSON string format.
For string params (version, file_name): filters value != param value
For list params (urls, acl): filters records that don't include the param value
For dict params (metadata, urls_metadata), for each (key,value) pair:
- if param value is None or empty: filters with key doesn't exist
- if param value is provided: filters with value != param value OR key doesn't exist
number of records to return for this page, default to 100
pagination support without relying on dids. offsets results by limit*page
